name: com.crosodo/mcp
title: Crosodo
description: Cottage-food law, county 4-Box permits, food legality, label previews and baker dashboard tools.

tools.name: lookup_state_law
tools.description: Cottage-food / home-bakery requirements for a US state from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset: sales cap, registration, allowed products, statute, and agency links. Accepts a 2-letter abbrev (VA) or slug (virginia). Unknown states return an error — never invented data. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

tools.name: lookup_county
tools.description: County-level cottage-food requirements for a US state + county from Crosodo's structured county dataset (contacts, verification status, local URLs, state summaries). Unknown states or counties return an error — never invented data. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

county.description: County name or slug (lancaster or Lancaster County)

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The Crosodo catalog: free state-law report ($0), Cottage Pro ($15 lifetime), Baker Starter Kit ($9), Label pack + calculator ($9), Crosodo Certified ($49). Retired SKUs still listed: Permit Guide 101 ($26) and Unlimited Pass ($97). Prices come from the same constants as the site. Does not create a checkout session.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session server-side and returns { checkoutUrl, product, sessionId }. Hand the URL to the user; payment completes on Stripe's hosted page. This never charges. product: cottage_pro | county_packet | label_calc_pack | certified_exam. county_packet is county-specific (state + county required); label_calc_pack needs state. permit_guide and unlimited_pass are retired — checkout returns an error pointing at Cottage Pro / the $9 kit / the $9 pack. Pass idempotencyKey so agent retries cannot double-create sessions.

product.description: Purchasable product id from list_products. permit_guide and unlimited_pass are retired and cannot be checked out.

state.description: Required for county_packet (2-letter abbrev or slug)

email.description: Buyer email, prefilled at Stripe Checkout

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key; retries with the same key reuse the Stripe session

tools.name: verify_certification
tools.description: Public lookup of a Crosodo Certified credential (format CC-{ST}-{YY}-{XXXX}, for example CC-VA-26-1042; that ID only illustrates the format and is not a real credential, so looking it up returns Credential not found). Returns public fields only (holder display name, dates, status). Unknown, expired, or revoked credentials return an error. No auth.

certId.description: Credential ID in the format CC-{ST}-{YY}-{XXXX} (e.g. CC-VA-26-1042, format example only, not a real credential)

tools.name: get_my_dashboard
tools.description: The signed-in baker's dashboard at a glance: bakery place/level, business name, 4-Box municipal permit status, 6-stage baker journey next action, access (Cottage Pro / Unlimited Pass), sales + expense totals, saved recipe & label names, and public storefront status. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:read).

tools.name: log_sale
tools.description: Add one sale to the signed-in baker's sales log (same record the Financials tab creates). Free for every signed-in user. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

tools.name: log_expense
tools.description: Add one expense to the signed-in baker's Financials tab. Cottage Pro from the first entry (same rule as the dashboard). Amounts are the baker's own numbers. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Save (or update, with id) a recipe in the signed-in baker's Foods Recipes library. Ingredient costs are the baker's own package costs — never invent prices. First saved recipe is free; the library beyond that is Cottage Pro (same rule as the dashboard). Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

id.description: Existing recipe id to update (from get_my_dashboard or a previous save)

name.description: Recipe name, e.g. Sourdough sandwich loaf

ingredients.description: Ingredients with the baker's entered package costs

usedQty.description: Quantity used per batch, same unit

allergens.description: Allergen names as the baker states them

tools.name: get_permit_checklist
tools.description: The signed-in baker's county permit checklist (active Permits workspace or active bakery county, or fips) with each step's requirement, official URL, and done flag. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:read).

tools.name: set_permit_step
tools.description: Check or uncheck one step on the signed-in baker's permit checklist (same check mark the Permits tab toggles). Get step ids from get_permit_checklist. Requires a Permit Guide purchase or full-library access, same as the dashboard. OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

tools.name: get_four_box_checklist
tools.description: Maps any US county or independent city into Crosodo's universal 4-Box municipal permit framework across 4 government departments: (1) Food & Kitchen Authority, (2) Zoning & Home Address Use, (3) Business Entity & Local License, and (4) Sales Tax, Cap & Channels. Each box reports an explicit disposition (EXEMPT_BY_STATUTE, SELF_COMPLY, FILING_REQUIRED, CONDITIONAL_ON_ANSWERS, UNVERIFIED_FALLBACK), fees, official .gov links, and recommended filing order. Works anonymously (pass state + county or fips) or merges saved checkmarks when signed in. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev (e.g. VA, CA, TX) or state name/slug

county.description: County or independent city name/slug (e.g. Fairfax County or fairfax)

fips.description: Optional 5-digit county/city FIPS instead of state + county

level.description: Vertical ladder rung 1..4 (1=Hobby, 2=Cottage Food [default], 3=Inspected Home Kitchen, 4=Commercial)

tools.name: check_food_legality
tools.description: Checks Crosodo's 43-food × 51-jurisdiction 'Can I Sell This?' dataset for a specific food and US state: returns verdict (yes | conditional | no), state statute citation, food-safety rationale (pH / water activity), and whether Rung 3 (Inspected Kitchen) is required. No auth required. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

food.description: Food name or slug, e.g. 'sourdough-bread', 'cookies', 'cream cheese frosting', 'cheesecake'

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev (e.g. VA, TX, CA) or state name/slug

tools.name: setup_bakery_business
tools.description: Saves the signed-in baker's county/city, vertical ladder rung (1=Hobby, 2=Cottage Food, 3=Inspected Kitchen, 4=Commercial), and optional business name / baker name / street address on Crosodo, then returns their 4-Box municipal assessment and 6-stage journey status. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev or state name

fips.description: Optional 5-digit FIPS instead of state + county

tools.name: generate_compliant_label
tools.description: Sorts recipe ingredients by descending weight (when gram/oz/lb weights are supplied), detects FDA Big-9 allergens, attaches the verbatim state cottage-food disclaimer from Crosodo's state labeling matrix, and returns print/Canva-ready label copy. Works anonymously for previewing; pass save: true when signed in (crosodo:write) to save the draft to the baker's dashboard Labels library (first saved label free; more require Cottage Pro). Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev (e.g. VA, TX, CA) or state name

productName.description: Product name on the package, e.g. Country Sourdough Loaf

ingredients.description: Comma-separated ingredients (include weights like '500g bread flour, 375g water, 10g salt' to auto-sort descending)

allergens.description: Optional explicit allergens to merge with auto-detected FDA Big-9 allergens

netWeight.description: Package net weight, e.g. '24 oz (680 g)'

businessName.description: Bakery or producer name printed on the label

address.description: Street address or state registration ID printed on the label

fips.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS for county-level label notes

canvaTemplateUrl.description: Optional Canva design URL to link to the saved draft

save.description: Set true to save this label draft to the signed-in baker's dashboard

tools.name: configure_storefront_profile
tools.description: Claims or updates the signed-in baker's public Crosodo storefront page at crosodo.com/p/{handle} (minimum 10 characters). Preserves the live approved snapshot while edits await moderation so the baker's URL never goes offline. Requires OAuth sign-in (crosodo:write).

handle.description: Public URL handle (10-40 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens), e.g. 'hearth-and-crumb'

headline.description: Short tagline, e.g. 'Naturally leavened sourdough in Fairfax, VA'

bio.description: About your bakery, bake days, and pickup/market schedule

website.description: Optional order form or website URL

platform.description: instagram | facebook | tiktok | youtube | pinterest | x | etsy | website | other

socialLinks.description: Social accounts included in the profile review payload (published only after approval)
